title: From typed text to a post
description: A composer is a small form with a gatekeeper. Trace the text field to canPublish and publishPost, note trimming and the 300-character rule, and follow how the new record is placed at the top without mutating the previous list.
learning_objectives: Explain composer validation, length limits, and immutable insertion in plain language.
Trace export function publishPost in `src/feed.ts` and explain the relevant behavior.
State and preserve this limit: Publishing stores a local post; there is no authenticated AT Protocol write.
